mapper.insert: INSERT INTO login_logs (email, user_id, ip, user_agent, result) VALUES (#{email}, #{userId}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{result})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_logs WHERE result <> 'success' AND created_at >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM login_logs WHERE result = 'locked' AND created_at >= CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email, ip) FROM login_logs WHERE result <> 'success' AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
SELECT email, ip, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM login_logs WHERE result <> 'success' GROUP BY email, ip ORDER BY failures DESC, email ASC, ip ASC LIMIT #{limit}
